remediation_actions.likely_cause: Stiffness matrix is non-positive definite; typically caused by unconstrained rigid body modes, material instability, or contact opening.
remediation_actions.suggested_remediation: Check boundary conditions for unconstrained rigid body motions, verify contact stabilization, or check plasticity/hyperelasticity parameters.

remediation_actions.likely_cause: Solver exceeded maximum cutback count without achieving equilibrium.
remediation_actions.suggested_remediation: Inspect severity of residual force / displacement correction, check material softening, or relax cutback controls if physics are smooth.

remediation_actions.likely_cause: Ill-conditioned stiffness matrix near node or DOF.
remediation_actions.suggested_remediation: Verify elastic modulus consistency, node connectivity, and tie constraints.

assumptions_added: Encastre boundary condition applied to fully constrain rigid modes
